progression.narrative: The performance opens on B2 and dwells most on B in Saghinameh. Koshteh Mordeh (0:12.7) introduces Ek, centred on D#. Sufinameh (0:41.9) introduces C#, D#, F#, Gk, centred on F#. The line peaks at Gk4 (380.4 Hz) at 2:27.2. It closes on Ek4, not the tonic (D#4 → C#4 → Ek4 → Ck4 → Ek4 → Ek4).
